tool.name: Inspect AnnData
tool.description: Inspect AnnData dataset and extract components

command.script:
import sys import pandas as pd import anndata as ad import json
# Read input input_path = sys.argv[1] output_info = sys.argv[2] output_x = sys.argv[3] output_x_chunk = sys.argv[4] output_obs = sys.argv[5] output_var = sys.argv[6]
# Load AnnData adata = ad.read(input_path)
# General info info = { 'shape': adata.shape, 'n_obs': adata.n_obs, 'n_vars': adata.n_vars, 'n_vars': adata.n_vars, 'isbacked': adata.isbacked } with open(output_info, 'w') as f: json.dump(info, f, indent=2)
# Full X matrix pd.DataFrame(adata.X).to_csv(output_x, index=False)
# Chunked X matrix chunk = next(adata.chunk_X(1000)) pd.DataFrame(chunk).to_csv(output_x_chunk, index=False)
# Obs and Var adata.obs.to_csv(output_obs, index=False) adata.var.to_csv(output_var, index=False)

tool.help:
# AnnData Inspector
This tool extracts and inspects components of an AnnData object:
- **General Information**: Basic metadata about the dataset - **Full X Matrix**: Complete data matrix as CSV - **Chunked X Matrix**: Sampled portion of the data matrix - **Observations (obs)**: Row annotations - **Variables (var)**: Column annotations
## AnnData Overview
AnnData is a Python package for handling annotated data matrices, widely used in single-cell analysis. It stores:
- `X`: Main data matrix - `obs`: Row annotations (observations) - `var`: Column annotations (variables) - `uns`: Unstructured annotations
## Input
Requires an AnnData file (`.loom` or `.h5ad` format).
## Output
- `output_info`: JSON file with dataset metadata - `output_x`: Full data matrix as CSV - `output_x_chunk`: Sampled data matrix as CSV - `output_obs`: Observations table as CSV - `output_var`: Variables table as CSV
## Example
Processing a typical single-cell RNA-seq dataset will yield:
- Basic statistics about cells and genes - Expression values matrix - Metadata for cells and genes
